probeDesign.client: hand-written JSON-RPC over stdio (newline-delimited), initialize with protocolVersion 2025-06-18, capabilities.elicitation.form, clientInfo codex-mcp-client/Codex 0.160.0

probeDesign.noClientTimeout: tools/call waits indefinitely (600 s safety guard only); js timeout_ms is passed explicitly
probeDesign.elicitationPolicy: stage 1 answers any unexpected request with cancel; stage 2 uses --elicit accept|cancel|delay
probeDesign.redaction: keys matching /token|key|secret|account|password|cookie|authorization/i are replaced with [redacted] in logs and summaries; env values are never logged

recommendedEnv.rationale: The verbatim .mcp.json environment plus Codex-shaped _meta returned both the app inventory and the Chrome browser inventory. The bridge derives CUA_REPL_ENABLED_SURFACES and NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_SERVICES from the feature flags (variant c proved computer-only works with NODE_REPL_TRUSTED_SERVICES removed).
recommendedEnv.serviceAppStrategy: Keep SKY_CUA_SERVICE_PATH from .mcp.json when present (~/.codex/computer-use). Variant d (path pointed at the copy inside @oai/sky) also returned the inventory, but the service was already running, so launching from that copy is still unproven.
recommendedEnv.baseEnvironment: Pass an allow-listed base environment, not the whole pi process environment.

metaRequired.evidence: Run b (no _meta) returned the 52-app inventory but browsers:[] with errors:["Browsers: Error: Missing required Codex turn metadata: session_id, turn_id"]; run a (with x-codex-turn-metadata) returned the Chrome inventory. node_repl itself reads only model, node_repl_auto_review_required and node_repl_disabled from x-codex-turn-metadata (binary strings); no model-name allow-list was found in the binary.
